process.name: Book a place on a workshop
process.description: Reserve a place, take payment and confirm by email.
process.try:
Open /workshops and pick a date with free places.
Book with card 4242 4242 4242 4242 and any future expiry.
Check the confirmation mail in /letter_opener.

outcomes.name: confirmed
outcomes.then: the booking is saved, the place count goes down and the confirmation mail is sent

why: Payment is taken before the place is held so that abandoned checkouts never block a seat.
Confirmation goes by mail rather than SMS because most bookings come from the studio's newsletter.
